title: [Question] Compiling
body: Is there a way I could compile the rich presence plugin so I get a usable .dll like you have in the workshop mod? Thanks
author: Verssgn

comments.body: hello, you'll need a .NET compiler, via Visual Studio/Visual Studio Code + dotnet/Rider...etc, setup environment variable `ElinGamePath` to the game's root folder, then load the project ElinRichPresence.csproj and compile it.
